title: Behavioral Interventions
tagline: Changing what can be changed, measurably.
welcome: Behavior is communication and habit at once. This course teaches you to change it with precision, kindness, and data.
vignette: A seven-year-old's tantrums last forty minutes and end the family's evenings. The parents are exhausted and blaming each other. A functional assessment reveals the pattern; a two-week plan changes the house. Behavior work is hope made operational.
vignette_attr: A parent consultation, drawn from practice
description: A practical course in behavioral theory and intervention with young people: functional behavioral assessment, reinforcement and extinction, token and contract systems, parent training principles, school-based behavior plans, and data-based decision making.
questions: How do we change it without shaming the child?
importance: Behavior problems are the most common referral for children
Effective behavioral plans transform homes and classrooms
Data keeps intervention honest and adjustable
misconceptions: that behavioral methods are punishment, when they are overwhelmingly about teaching and reinforcing
that they ignore feelings, when function includes emotion and need
figures: whose analysis of operant behavior underlies the field
who mapped coercive family cycles and parent training
who advanced evidence-based parent management training
outcomes: You will identify function from interview, observation, and data.
You will build token, contract, and praise systems that work.
You will reduce problem behavior while teaching alternatives.
You will train caregivers with clarity and empathy.
You will write plans teachers can actually run.
You will graph, review, and adjust intervention from data.
modules: The contingency is the atom of behavioral work.
We reinforce what we want and teach what replaces what we don't.
A well-built system outlives the counselor's presence.
Parents are the true interventionists; we coach them.
Data is how we respect the child enough to be accurate.
practicum: A full functional assessment of a real case
Design and run a token system
assessment: Assessment is case and data based.
A behavior intervention plan with data plan
tips: Define the behavior so two strangers could count it
Graph weekly; decide from the curve
integration: Behavioral competence supports school, family, and clinical work across the programme.
faith: We shape behavior with patience and praise, believing every child can learn new ways.
closing: May your plans be precise and your patience long, and may homes be changed one reinforced step at a time.
